<style>
/* ── Password overlay ───────────────────────────────── */
#pw-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;

  z-index: 9999;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 18px;
}

.pw-box {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #dde3ea;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 40px 48px;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  max-width: 400px;
  width: 90%;
}

.pw-box h2 {
  margin: 0 0 6px 0;
  font-size: 1.5em;
  color: #2c3e50;
}

.pw-box p {
  color: #666;
  font-size: 0.95em;
  margin: 0 0 22px 0;
}

.pw-input-row {
  display: flex;

}

.pw-input-row input {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 1em;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color .2s;
}

.pw-input-row input:focus {

}

.pw-input-row button {
  padding: 10px 18px;
  background: #2980b9;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 1em;
  cursor: pointer;

}

.pw-error {

<!--  PASSWORD SCRIPT                                  -->
<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
// SHA-256 hash of the access password.
// To change the password: run  echo -n "your_new_password" | sha256sum
// and replace the string below.
const CORRECT_HASH = "d6217001f8281b909b681adbfaeefe2f09e6772662d5cf963c221ba4ac17cec0";

async function sha256(message) {
  const msgBuffer = new TextEncoder().encode(message);
  const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", msgBuffer);
  const hashArray  = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
  return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

async function checkPw() {
  const input = document.getElementById("pw-input").value;
  const hash  = await sha256(input);
  if (hash === CORRECT_HASH) {
    document.getElementById("pw-overlay").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("course-content").style.display = "block";
    // Remember in session so refresh doesn't re-ask
    sessionStorage.setItem("rcourse_unlocked", "1");
  } else {
    const err = document.getElementById("pw-error");
    err.textContent = "Incorrect password. Please try again.";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").value = "";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").focus();
    setTimeout(() => { err.textContent = ""; }, 3000);
  }
}

// Auto-unlock if already authenticated this session
if (sessionStorage.getItem("rcourse_unlocked") === "1") {
  document.getElementById("pw-overlay").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("course-content").style.display = "block";
}
</script>
